5056095713283.variantName: True Products 6ft Pre-Lit Norwegian Fir Artificial Christmas Tree - Multi Colour & Warm White Lights
5056095713283.sourceDescription:
Set the scene for a cosy Christmas with our Pre-Lit Norwegian Fir Christmas Tree. Its traditional silhouette and combination of multi colour or warm white LED lights bring a welcoming glow to your home, ready for festive evenings and family celebrations. Available heights, 6ft and 7ft.

This Norwegian Fir combines realistic PE tips with PVC tips. The mixed tips give the foliage texture and depth, creating a natural-looking setting for treasured ornaments and your chosen Christmas colour scheme.

With the lights already fitted, you can get straight to the enjoyable part of decorating. Choose a steady glow for relaxed evenings, a little twinkle for festive sparkle or a gentle slow fade. There are 9 multifunction settings to choose from, with the lights mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to bring out the tree's shape, then finish with your favourite baubles, ribbons and tree topper.

Features:
 Light functions: 9 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 6ft / 1.8m
Diameter: 116cm
Tip count: 1029 (549 PE and 480 PVC)
Lights: 450 multi colour LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

0791537537083.sourceDescription: Space Saving Pop Up Design: This 5ft artificial Christmas tree features a collapsible pull-up design, allowing for effortless assembly and disassembly in minutes. Supported by a robust central metal stand, it stands stably while taking up minimal space, making it an excellent holiday decoration choice for small living rooms, apartments, narrow hallways, and office corners. Iridescent Tinsel Reflective Foil: Crafted with high-quality white iridescent tinsel needles, this slim pencil tree shimmers beautifully as it catches the light from different angles, creating a magical holographic rainbow effect. The dense, metallic tinsel material is flame-retardant and safe, offering a modern, winter-wonderland alternative to traditional green holiday trees. Complimentary LED Star String Lights: Every collapsible tinsel tree comes with a free 4.5-metre battery-operated string light featuring 30 LEDs with snowflake and star-shaped covers. The warm, enchanting glow weaves through the tinsel branches, instantly illuminating your home with a cosy, festive ambience without needing extra hanging ornaments. Durable Construction and Stability: Engineered with a heavy-duty metal core frame and a four-legged floor base, this narrow holiday coastal tree avoids tilting or wobbling. The flexible pop-up structure allows you to fold it down into a compact box at the end of the festive season, ensuring easy, flat storage for the next year. Versatile Indoor Festive Decor: A stunning choice for minimalist, modern, coastal, or vintage holiday themes. This 5-foot skinny Xmas tree brings festive cheer to indoor spaces such as bedrooms, dining rooms, retail shop windows, classrooms, and parties, serving as a bright, eye-catching backdrop for winter celebrations.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Metal. Stated size: 20 cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Compact design fits small spaces and stores easily between uses.
Reusable construction allows for repeated festive display with simple care.
Metal frame provides a sturdy base for durable seasonal decoration.
Versatile decorative piece enhances any Christmas arrangement or focal point.

Comes pre-assembled

Hanging Cord

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

5037204461783.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Material: Foam. Quantity: 32 pack.
Pack of 32 festive foam decorations for versatile home styling
Lightweight foam construction allows easy arrangement and display flexibility
Designed to add a practical decorative detail to any Christmas display
Ideal for creating focal points within coordinated holiday arrangements
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering

Product Description

 This Christmas tree collar is made of soft plush fabric with Gold snowflake embroidery, adding a warm and luxurious touch to your holiday tree.

5056903233583.sourceDescription:
Bring red foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 4 artificial fern garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Feathery fronds with narrow leaflets branch along the garland, creating an open foliage outline with a glittered surface. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the red colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 4 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Fern Garland: Includes 4 matching red artificial fern leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Feathery fronds with narrow leaflets branch along the garland, creating an open foliage outline with a glittered surface. The red colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the red fern foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 4 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

8635560241383.baseName: 1 Pack Extra Large Velvet Christmas Bow, 50 cm Tree Topper with 180 cm Ribbon Tail, Deep Red
8635560241383.variantName: 1 Pack Extra Large Velvet Christmas Bow, 50 cm Tree Topper with 180 cm Ribbon Tail, Deep Red
8635560241383.sourceDescription:
Make a tree, door or staircase look properly dressed with this oversized velvet bow, cut generously enough to hold its own against a full Christmas display.

The bow spans about 50 cm across, with a ribbon width of around 25 cm and two long tails that hang approximately 1.8 m. That scale is what makes the difference: a small bow disappears against a tall tree or a wide door, while this one reads clearly from across a room and photographs well.

Velvet gives it structure as well as richness. The fabric holds the loops upright instead of drooping, and the pile picks up tree lights and candlelight with a soft sheen, which is why the deep red looks warm rather than flat. The vintage style loop shape suits traditional schemes, and the same bow works with neutral, gold or green decorations.

A fixing strap on the reverse means it can be tied to the top of a tree, a wreath, a banister, a chair back or a mantle shelf in seconds, and it can be moved around the house as the mood takes you. Use it as a tree topper, a door bow, a backdrop for a party table or a statement piece above a fireplace.

Because the shape is generous and the tails are long, drape the ribbon rather than pulling it tight, and let the ends fall unevenly for a more relaxed look. Store the bow flat or lightly stuffed so the loops keep their form.

Because the loops are generous, the bow can be dressed by hand after unpacking and will hold whatever shape it is given. The tails are long enough to trail down a staircase or around a wreath and can be trimmed shorter for a tighter look. It also stores flat, so it comes out without the crushed, creased look that ribbon bows develop after a year in a bag. Use it above a fireplace, on a front door or as the centrepiece of a party table.

One pack contains one large velvet bow with fixing strap.
Extra Large 50 cm Bow: Generous loops and a wide ribbon read clearly against a tall tree or a front door, where a standard bow simply disappears
1.8 m Ribbon Tails: Two long tails drape down a tree, banister or mantle, giving the display movement and a properly finished, dressed look
Structured Velvet: The pile holds the loops upright instead of drooping and catches tree lights with a soft sheen, so the deep red looks warm not flat
Fixing Strap Included: Ties to a tree top, wreath, banister, chair back or shelf in seconds, and can be moved around the house through the season
Vintage Loop Shape: A traditional bow silhouette that suits red and gold schemes, neutral decorations and green foliage, reusable year after year
For Indoor Use
Shatterproof

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif for festive seasonal character.
Crafted from durable fabric material suitable for repeated holiday use.
Versatile decorative detail that creates a focal point for Christmas displays.
Single set design allows easy placement on doors or within home arrangements.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5096042276683.sourceDescription:
Small Bakuli pods give this hand-assembled wreath a close, richly textured surface. The laurel-green colour unifies the shapes, while the natural differences from pod to pod give each ring a slightly different appearance. At 40 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree.

A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror. For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.

When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go. A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.

For an entrance used throughout the day, use a fixing suited to the door finish and the weight of the decoration. A trial positioning helps you check the view from both sides of an open door before committing to a spot. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments.
Handmade from natural Bakuli seed pods for a richly textured, unique festive appearance.
Compact 40 cm diameter design fits perfectly on doors or walls without occupying excessive space.
Versatile decoration suitable for hanging on doors, walls, or displaying on consoles and mantelpieces.
Laurel green colour unifies the natural pod shapes, creating a cohesive and elegant seasonal look.

5096042277383.sourceDescription:
Natural materials give this wooden wreath a varied surface beneath the decorative snow. Pine cones, red berries and white snowflakes are arranged around an open centre that shows the colour of the door behind it. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 36 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme. The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design.

Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height.
Decorated with natural pine cones, red berries and white snowflakes for a festive woodland look.
Versatile design suitable for both indoor and outdoor use on doors or walls.
Compact 36 cm diameter size ideal for hallways, mantels and smaller entrance spaces.
Features an open centre design that allows the background colour to show through.

5071948859383.sourceDescription:
Autumn Decoration
This autumn decoration adds a decorative detail to the chosen display. The yellow finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for home decoration.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Yellow. Product measurements: length 2 cm. Quantity: 2 pack.
